credit: Uncertainty feels worse than bad news

lines.text: You send one TEXT. It says: seen.
lines.say: You send one Text. It says: seen.

lines.text: Stay for the REPLY. It is three words.
lines.say: Stay for the Reply. It is three words.

lines.text: Minute four. You REREAD your message.
lines.say: Minute four. You Reread your message.

lines.text: Minute twenty. Are they ONLINE? They are.
lines.say: Minute twenty. Are they Online? They are.

lines.text: Hour two. Phone face down. You last ELEVEN seconds.
lines.say: Hour two. Phone face down. You last Eleven seconds.

lines.text: Hour three. Your brain opens the ARCHIVE.

lines.text: Hour five. You write a follow-up. You DELETE it.

lines.text: Hour nine. They HATE you. Evidence: zero.
lines.say: Hour nine. They Hate you. Evidence: zero.

lines.text: But no reply is not bad news. It is NO news.
lines.say: But no reply is not bad news. It is No news.

lines.text: Your brain fills the BLANK with the worst version.
lines.say: Your brain fills the Blank with the worst version.

lines.text: Hour twenty-three. It lights up. You STARE.
lines.say: Hour twenty-three. It lights up. You Stare.

lines.text: My phone DIED. Seven spirals. One dead battery.
lines.say: My phone Died. Seven spirals. One dead battery.

lines.text: How long were YOU left on read?

lines.text: Send this to the FRIEND who takes nine hours to reply.

post.title: Your Brain on Read for 24 Hours #shorts
post.description: How long were you left on read? Send this to the friend who takes nine hours to reply. You send one text. It says seen. Then nothing. Here is every spiral your brain runs in the next 24 hours, and why: no reply is not bad news, it is no news, and a mind that hates uncertainty fills the blank with the worst version. #psychology #shorts #overthinking
